name: Shinnin Kyoushi ~Kateikyoushi wa Chitsunai Shasei ga Osuki?!
original_name: 娠妊教師～家庭教師は膣内射精がお好き?!
source:
The game's protagonist is a home tutor. He harbors a secret crush on Kashiwagi Maki, one of his students.
Then one day, suddenly, there's a confession of love and their sex life begins.
They're alone together in the house during the day, so he forgets all about her studies in order to spend every day having passionate sex with her.
But then her pregnancy leads to a friend, Sawada Kyouko, getting involved in their lives of lust and violation.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ042198.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
游戏的主角是一位家庭教师。他暗恋着自己的学生之一柏木真希。
然后有一天，突然间，他们表白了爱情，他们的性生活开始了。
白天他们独自一人待在家里，所以他忘记了她的学业，每天都在与她进行激情的性爱。
但随后她的怀孕导致她的朋友泽田恭子卷入了他们的欲望和侵犯的生活。
